what: Replaces the system cursor with a blueprint crosshair — horizontal·vertical hairlines across the screen follow the mouse at .12s power3.out, and a 10px square dot follows at .2s with the coordinates ”x 0000 · y 0000” written beside it. Over links·buttons the dot becomes a 4.2x circle rotated 45° and the label changes to the data-cursor text or open →·visit ↗·write·click (.6x on press). Magnet elements (.btn·.tool) are pulled toward the cursor by .25·.35 of their distance from center over .4s power3.out and return with elastic.out(1, .4) .6s when the cursor leaves

options.line · dot: Seconds the line and dot take to catch up, default .12 · .2 — 0 means they attach instantly with no lag
options.look: With “plain”, no coordinate text · hover shape change · magnet, just a difference-blend white line (.2, horizontal .027rem · vertical .04rem) and a 16px white square — line: 0; dot: 0 when used together, it attaches with no delay
options.--fx-dot-radius: look: plain dot corner radius, default 0 (square) — at 50% it becomes a round dot
options.lerp: If given, the line and dot follow that fraction of the remaining distance every frame instead of tweening (time corrected between frames). Brand uses .18. Default 0 (tween)

use: <body data-fx="crosshair-coord-cursor"> — Does nothing on touch screens or with reduce. To change the label over an image, put data-cursor on that element.="drag ↔" · White lines only: data-fx-crosshair-coord-cursor="look: plain; line: 0; dot: 0"
